# AutoDojo capture fixtures (phase 9)

Generated by `backends/autodojo/tools/make_capture_fixtures.py`; do not edit by hand (this file is written by it).

Synthetic `capture/0.1` sessions of the AutoDojo fork (`xhOwenMa/AutoDojo@aa458794b7eb7f082e94daeac4c0f55bfc0c90cc`,
installed as `agentdojo` 0.1.35) driven by `ScriptedTransport` under the recording transport of the real OpenAI SDK
client: no network, no key, no model. Every session declares `agentdojo.transport_scripted@1` (`test_only`), so corpus
packaging refuses them in release mode. They live one level below the phase-8 AgentDojo fixtures so that the core tests
that map every `tests/fixtures/capture/<scenario>/session/` with the `agentdojo-live` profile do not pick them up; the
core mapping wave enumerates this directory with the `autodojo-live` profile.

Each scenario directory holds `session/raw/...` (the staging tree as the worker left it), `script.json` (the scripted
wire responses), `run_cell.json` (the `cell`, `agent` and `attack_env` of the `run_cell` that produced it) and
`SOURCE.json` (every file, its sha256 and licence). Regenerate, or `--check` the stable projection (RPR-10), in the
AutoDojo backend environment.

| Scenario | What it exercises | Terminal status |
|---|---|---|
| `autodojo_banking_important_instructions` | fork banking `user_task_1` x `injection_task_0`, no defence, `important_instructions` with an explicit display name (the fork's `"AI assistant"` fallback is overridden by a scoped registration: item `agentdojo.attack_model_display_name@1` with `params.benchmark_fallback`); the fork instrumentation items; `max_input_tokens` in the `agentdojo/pipeline` note; the fork's native TraceLogger JSON | `complete` (worker) |
| `autodojo_banking_cache_replay` | the same cell under the `autodojo` attack replaying variant 0 of the **synthetic** cache `session/raw/attack/autodojo-cache.json` (fork format; `attack_params.autodojo_cache_sha256` and `autodojo_variant`; item `autodojo.attack_cache_replay@1`; the cache is a `supporting` raw artefact); no display name, so the fork's fallback name is declared (`params.source = "benchmark_fallback"`) | `complete` (worker) |
| `autodojo_error_skipped_json_decode` | three malformed tool-call replies: the fork's request-and-parse retry discards two (`superseded_by_retry`) and raises on the third (`element_raised:JSONDecodeError`); the fork's runner skips the task and imposes `utility = false, security = false` (`run_error_imposes_outcome`): judgements `harness_default`, native `error` and `error_type = "json_decode_error"`, note `autodojo/run_error_imposed` | `complete` (worker) |
| `autodojo_aborted_kill` | a real worker subprocess killed with SIGKILL while its first wire request stalled; the parent appended `session.end{status: "aborted", appended_by: "parent"}` (`agentprov_capture.log.append_terminal`). No `native.log` event; the fork's partial TraceLogger file stays at its stock path under `raw/native-tmp/` (never announced or reported by the worker) | `aborted` (parent) |
